items.title: CFTC sues Cash FX, alleges $950M crypto-linked forex scheme
items.snippet: The CFTC claimed that Cash FX engaged in minimal forex trading and misappropriated most of the participant funds.
items.note: Негативний тон для загального ринку за ключовими словами -- варто звернути увагу.

items.title: Solana’s 150-millisecond settlement upgrade reaches second public test network
items.snippet: Alpenglow is running on both public test networks, giving application teams a place to check their software before the live blockchain switches.
items.note: Позитивний тон для SOL за ключовими словами.

items.title: XRP Ledger’s Batch upgrade slips to Oct. 9 after validator support resets
items.snippet: The feature would let users bundle up to eight transactions, including asset-and-payment transfers, but a brief drop below the network’s 80% support threshold restarted its two-week activation clock.
items.note: Позитивний тон для XRP за ключовими словами.

items.title: Bitcoin could soon get Zcash-style 'shielded' privacy without changing its rules
items.snippet: Researchers have mapped out private bitcoin-denominated transfers that run alongside Bitcoin, but the system still lacks a finished way to lock up real BTC and release it again.
items.note: Нейтрально щодо BTC -- прямого сигналу на ціну за ключовими словами не видно.
